meta.description: 黑白机能票据、工业标签、控制台 UI 与新粗野主义信息设计混搭风格。强调高对比度、网格线与功能性排版。

canvas-guidelines.margin: Full bleed canvas with internal margins defined by borders.

color-palette.notes: Strictly black and white or grayscale. No colors allowed.

typography.title-style: 48-64px, Bold (700). Main title is strictly English Uppercase.
typography.special-text: Product descriptions use technical terms; Footer text uses monospace or small caps like 'S/N: XXX'.

shapes-and-effects.border-style: Stroke width 2-4px, solid black (#000000). Sharp or slightly rounded (rx=8).
shapes-and-effects.dividers: Thick black lines separating header, body, and footer.
shapes-and-effects.special-effects: Barcode simulation (vertical rects); Diagonal stripes for warning areas.

iconography.icon-style: Geometric, black stroke path or rect.
iconography.usage: Simple icons for servers, cloud, tools; Arrows constructed from lines and polygons.

pattern.description: Three-part structure: Header (Ticket info), Body (Modules), Footer (Status).

component.description: Content module box with title and points.

component.shape: Series of vertical lines of varying width.

component.border-or-fill: Black border, text inside such as 'CHECK IN'.

generation-guidelines.role: You are an SVG designer specializing in Industrial Brutalism and Ticket UI styles.
generation-guidelines.usage: Create a 16:9 slide. Header with big UPPERCASE title and barcode. Body divided into 3-5 distinct modules with heavy borders. Footer with status info. Use only Black/White.
generation-guidelines.recommended-workflow: Draw background -> Draw thick header/footer lines -> Place title and barcode -> Draw body module boxes -> Fill text content -> Add icons/arrows.

negative-guidelines.forbidden-colors: No colors allowed. No gray scale shading/gradients.
negative-guidelines.notes: Avoid cute styles. Avoid realistic photos.
